segments.text: We're constantly competing for the same resources which made scaling our team almost

impossible. When we first heard it was available in Australia, we had to jump on the opportunity. Within just a few weeks, we found that the candidate was supporting customers and projects very successfully.
This program is changing the way that we construct our business central teams.

The BC talent team have our interests at heart and I really think this is a partnership of unlimited potential. It enables us to get consultants that have industry experience and also are trained up in business central.

It brings consultants up to speed really quickly. It also helps taking the pressure off the existing team because the structure of the program supports the person coming in and they get good education.

The first two that we've had through it been a great success. So now it's all in. I see a future where the BC talent program is a critical component of the enablement strategy of all business central partners whether it be upskill whether it be reskill whether it be recruit.
This has to be part of what you think about and offer to your team members.
